boards.name: The hub for one role, the rail for several
boards.idea: K's hybrid of Int-A and Int-B: a person with You only, or You and Family, sees the single My LCA page of Int-A; a person holding any volunteer section (Events you direct, Your region, Board, LCA admin, Member lookup) sees Int-B's left rail with one entry per section, and each entry opens the full room as its page. Drawn for Avery (member only), Danielle (member and parent) and Chris (member, parent, director, representative, treasurer), with the trigger rule in words.
boards.differs: Replaces the three frame options with the decided rule and shows both states side by side
boards.keeps: From Account-Int-A, unchanged: the one My LCA page at /dashboard for a person with no volunteer section (Avery with You only, Danielle with You and Family), its On this page list, no chips under two sections and nothing that hints at volunteer work; the decided header bar with the personal to-do count only (volunteer items never count there); the WS02 menu order; every decided room path (/workspace/tournaments/new, /workspace/tournaments/:id/setup, /live and /recap, /workspace/region and /workspace/region/clubs/:id, /board/inbox, /workspace/lookup), so WS08, WS09 and WS14 build as written; the word Workspace never shown as a title, a menu row or a crumb; the console's crumb band 'My LCA › Events you direct › The Baton Rouge Classic › Event day' with Exit console; the Done line after a finishing action; Admin as its own area at /admin for lca_admin with a second factor; the admin backstop strip 'You're here as an LCA admin'; no mode switch, with only the hall TV and print leaving the chrome; Avery, Danielle and Chris with their data. From Account-Int-B, unchanged: the 240px left rail with one entry per grant held, in a fixed order; the current entry with aria-current, bold type and the 3px gold bar; counts in words beside the entries, never colour alone; a live event pinned as its own entry for its days and 48 hours after; the rail folding into a 'My LCA ▾' crumb-menu on the console at 1024, a top row of tabs on tablets and a sheet behind the page title on phones; the short My LCA ▾ menu (to-dos, My LCA, the event line, Family, Membership card, the Admin row a person holds, Log out), the rail carrying the rooms; 'Two more people' worked through the same rule. From the frame object: the role inventory (who holds each grant and what it opens) and the Today rules as Account-H applies them.
boards.removes: The three frame options as options: Int-C goes whole (no second home, no Your work page, no second count beside the personal one). From Int-A: the long page for a volunteer (Chris's six sections on one page of about 3400px, collapsed and remembered per device), the named room rows in the My LCA ▾ menu for anyone with the rail, and 'Back to My LCA' in each room (the rail is the way back; Exit console and Admin's own Back to My LCA stay). From Int-B: the rail for a member or a parent with no volunteer section, the Overview cards (Account-H's role groups do that job), Settings as its own rail entry (it stays inside You), and the move of every route under /my (the decided paths stay). The officer rooms /workspace/tickets and /workspace/email (Account-P keeps Admin (view only), so tickets and the president's email stay in Admin). The frame-is-swappable sentence and the three side-by-side breadcrumbs on every board (the frame is decided). Int-A's and Int-B's open questions Q1 to Q3.

THE DECISION THIS BOARD DRAWS. K, Mon, Oct 19: 'Frame (I like A for general or no other role, but I prefer B when they have more than one role)'. On Today: 'we should not have this section as the default if that is the case, as in not open it first if its empty when they come to the My LCA'. Later the same day: 'everything else is fine as assumed'. The rule in words, as both boards state it: 'If all you hold is You, or You and Family, My LCA is one page. The moment you hold a volunteer section (Events you direct, Your region, Your club, Board, Admin, Member lookup), My LCA gains a left rail with one entry per section, and each entry opens its full room as its own page. When Today holds nothing it shrinks to one line, Nothing needs you today, and My LCA opens on You with your card.' Your club joins the list because K kept club reps on Mon, Oct 19 ('LCA admin, club reps, and the president'); a club rep holds more than one role, so B. Admin is the LCA admin section of Account-R, one row. Family is not a volunteer section, so a parent stays on one page.
